stemMd: Which follow-up most directly tests the door-seal intervention?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Measure only the colour of the panels

options.label: B
options.textMd: Compare incoming sound under similar music-room conditions before and after sealing

options.label: D
options.textMd: Assume any new seal guarantees complete silence

options.label: E
options.textMd: Count books without measuring or observing sound

explanationMd: The intervention targets transmission through the connecting door. Comparing incoming sound while keeping the source conditions similar directly evaluates that change. Reverberation and user observations can supplement, but do not replace, this targeted comparison.

distractorRationale.a: Colour does not test transmission through the door.
distractorRationale.e: Book count alone does not evaluate the specific intervention.
distractorRationale.d: The result should be checked rather than assumed.
distractorRationale.c: Area does not directly measure the leakage change.
